formattedAddress: No. 32號, Youya Rd, Linquan Village, Beitou District, Taipei City, Taiwan 112

displayName.text: 北投文物館-怡然居餐廳

text.text: Best meal of our trip in Taiwan so far. Every course was tantalising, ingredients were high quality, taste was sublime. Highlights were the first dish (black beans were incredibly sweet), third dish (interesting), fourth dish (prawn so fresh, pork so tender), sixth dish (finished last drop of the soup). Worth the price tag of ntd1430 after tax. Complimentary entry to the adjoined Beitou Museum if you have a reservation for a meal at Yiran house. If I had to suggest improvements, it would be to add some crabmeat to the chawanmushi (couldn't find any), and source for better quality fruits (watermelon was bland). Regardless, was a fantastic meal. Highly recommend.

text.text: Lovely dining space in a well maintained Japanese house. The course meal was tasty and well priced at 1,300 NTD plus 10% service charge. An interesting exhibition on beads through the ages and across the world was on at the museum's gallery. The museum gift shop stocked an interesting array of well crafted items. There's no entrance fee but visitors have to remove their shoes & put on the socks provided prior to entering the museum.

text.text: Had lunch with my wife after visiting the Beitou museum. No regrets. Pretty much every dish was very well executed, in terms of taste, portion, and presentation. Especially loved the prawn which was very fresh and tasty. Service was prompt and professional, ambience was bright and airy. Would try this again if I come again.

text.text: We had a party of 5 but did not have a reservation. The staff really tried to accommodate us for a spontaneous lunch. We were about to give up as it was fully booked until the staff ran out to tell us someone had just cancelled. It was perhaps our lucky day, but it was the staff’s effort and care that made our day. The food was refreshing, clean, but it was the environment that made the meal serene and zen-like. Thank you to the staff again.
